title: Not very efficient compared to using a traditional, spiral juicer
text: Not very efficient compared to using a traditional, spiral juicer. Leaves a lot of "meat" in the fruit where the juice hasn't been squeezed out, no matter how hard you press.  I went back to using the other style of juicer.  Also, nearly 2k reviews for this?  Some of those have to be faked by the manufacturer to push sales.  Overall, it seemed like a great idea but just doesn't work that well in execution.
